blocks.x: Police, fire, EMS and courts coordinate under minutes-matter constraints and the strictest accountability: evidence integrity, proportionality and privacy. Achala IT Solutions engineers the intelligence layer with auditability as a design primitive, not a feature. This page is the operating picture: what runs, what strains, and which capabilities move the numbers that decide the margin.

The work concentrates in dispatch and coordination, evidence management, report generation, with court scheduling close behind. Volume grows on every path; the decision layer has not kept up. That gap is measurable, and it is the work.
The recurring pressure points, Public Safety & Justice edition:

items: Dispatch, records and evidence systems siloed; coordination manual.
Reports, discovery and scheduling consume officer/court time.
